pairs.subject: retry-backoff
pairs.evidence: features/labs/rentgen/getTerminalData.ts:80 The context's only I/O is a read-only, once-per-render read of the in-process embedded store, and its failure lane is a single caught attempt that is reported and degraded per layer. No retry is attempted, so the subject's precondition (a failed call that the system then retries) does not hold; a case-insensitive grep of features/labs/rentgen/ for retry|retries|backoff|jitter|circuit|breaker|setInterval|attempt returned no hits.

techniques.evidence: features/labs/rentgen/getTerminalData.ts:114 Every failure goes to report-and-degrade with no retry decision, so there is nothing to classify for retry.
features/labs/rentgen/getTerminalData.ts:159 Each layer gets exactly one read per render. There is no retry ladder to tune and no delay.
features/labs/rentgen/getTerminalData.ts:12 The loader writes nothing and starts no backfill, so no retry state needs to survive a restart.
features/labs/rentgen/getTerminalData.ts:158 React cache() dedupes the read within a request, and since nothing retries there is no herd to control.
features/labs/rentgen/getTerminalData.ts:167 No retries happen. Total degradation is still traced through reportLoaderFailure.
